resources.string: A Debian development image with local SSH for Android’s Linux Terminal

Enable the Linux development environment in Developer options, start the system Terminal, and install its Debian VM. Allow Terminal to access shared storage. Installation supports the Android 16 Ferrochrome v4 image (build 4000000). Back up your Terminal VM before replacing its system disk.
Replace the Terminal VM system disk?

Back up files and projects from the existing Terminal VM. Installing the bundled Debian system can erase its apps, packages and project files. The next step prepares files in Downloads. Disk changes start only after you run the command in Terminal and confirm there.

Run the command in the original Terminal guest and type REPLACE when prompted. Save the printed SHA256 host fingerprint, shut down the VM using sudo poweroff, then reopen Terminal and allow local port 2222 in its port forwarding settings.
The installer preserves the original system disk. To roll back, run this command in the replacement Debian terminal, type RESTORE when prompted, then shut down the VM and reopen Terminal.
Remove the temporary image, installer and public key from Downloads after the guest installation finishes?
